blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Limited tumour visibility on intra-operative images complicates surgical navigation, including liver hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) targeting on computed tomography (CT) imaging. This makes labelled datasets difficult to curate for deep learning, and transferring pre-operative delineations through registration remains challenging due to intra-operative deformation and lack of paired pre- and intra-operative data. We propose to transfer tumour appearances learned from pre-operative magnetic resonance (MR) images to guide localisation on intra-operative CT through weak supervision. A classifier is trained to classify tumour presence on pre-operative images. This is applied to windows on intra-operative images, and despite the domain gap, it assigns higher tumour-presence probabilities on average to tumour-containing windows. These weak cross-domain signals guide a reinforcement learning agent to localise tumours on intra-operative images. We compare direct transfer, few-shot adaptation and synthetic transfer (trained using unpaired MR and CT), which translates CT into synthetic MR before localisation. On an external HCC cohort, synthetic transfer outperformed other tested methods and CT-only baselines. Our framework enables cross-modality tumour localisation without paired MR-CT training images.
blocks.zh: 手术内图像上的肿瘤可见度有限,使手术导航复杂化,包括肝肝细胞癌(HCC)针对计算成像(CT). 这使得贴有标签的数据集难以进行深层的学习,由于操作内变形和缺乏成对的操作前和操作内数据,通过登记转移操作前的划界仍然具有挑战性。 我们提议转移从术前磁共振图像中吸取的肿瘤外观,通过弱监督引导术内CT的局部化. 分类器在手术前图像上被训练为肿瘤存在分类. 这应用于操作内图像上的窗口,尽管域位差距很大,但它平均将较高的肿瘤存在概率分配给含有肿瘤的窗口. 这些薄弱的跨域信号引导一个强化学习剂在手术内图像上将肿瘤本地化. 我们比较直接转移,几发的适应和合成转移(使用未发光的MR和CT进行训练),在本地化前将CT转化为合成MR. 在一个外部合同委员会组群中,合成转移的绩效超过了其他经过测试的方法和只使用CT的基线。 我们的框架可以实现跨模式肿瘤定位,而不配对MR-CT训练图像。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Multi-modal imaging is central to modern clinical oncology, where complementary imaging modalities are acquired at different stages of care to maximise diagnostic accuracy and interventional precision [ 2 ] . A prominent example is the combined use of pre-operative magnetic resonance (MR) imaging and intra-operative computed tomography (CT) imaging in oncology, where each modality serves a distinct clinical role [ 5 ] . In liver oncology, pre-operative MR imaging provides soft-tissue contrast that supports tumour detection and delineation [ 4 ] . Intra-operative CT is rapidly acquired for navigation, but tumour visibility can be limited [ 13 , 17 ] . Lesions such as hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) may therefore be difficult to distinguish from surrounding liver parenchyma [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 多种模式成像是现代临床肿瘤学的核心,在不同的注意阶段获得互补成像模式,以最大限度地提高诊断精度和干预精度[2]. 一个突出的例子是在肿瘤学中综合使用术前磁共振成像和术后计算成形成像,其中每种模式都具有独特的临床作用[5]。 在肝肿瘤学中,手术前的MR成像提供了软-tissue对比,支持肿瘤检测和分界[4]. 术内CT被迅速得到来进行导航,但肿瘤能见度可以受到限制[13,17]. 因此,肝细胞癌(HCC)等病症可能难以与周围的肝脏瘤相区别[13].

blocks.en:
Transferring tumour localisation information from pre-operative to intra-operative imaging is therefore clinically important but technically challenging. Image registration offers a means of transferring pre-operative tumour delineations, but its application faces several challenges. Firstly, the limited availability of publicly accessible paired MR-CT images constrains the training of deep learning methods that require paired data [ 6 , 3 ] . Secondly, intra-operative liver displacement, respiratory motion and patient repositioning introduce non-rigid deformations that cannot be adequately captured by rigid alignment [ 6 ] . Thirdly, some unpaired deep learning-based deformable registration approaches rely on corresponding anatomical labels to guide alignment [ 6 ] ; obtaining reliable tumour labels in intra-operative CT is challenging for large datasets as lesion visibility is low, requiring expensive expert annotations [ 13 ] . Directly learning HCC localisation on intra-operative CT is similarly constrained by the substantial expert effort required to curate labelled training data. These challenges limit both registration-based label transfer
and direct learning of localisation for lesions with low
CT visibility, such as HCC. For example, recent approaches achieve lesion Dice scores of only 0.16-0.19 when MR and CT images are registered using tumour labels [ 13 ] .
These low tumour Dice scores contrast with reported anatomical structure Dice scores of 0.72, highlighting that broader anatomical alignment does not necessarily ensure accurate tumour label transfer [ 13 , 14 ] .
blocks.zh:
因此,将肿瘤本地化信息从术前成像转移到术后成像中,在临床上很重要,但技术上具有挑战性。 图像注册提供了转移手术前肿瘤分界的方法,但其应用面临若干挑战. 首先,可公开获取的配对MR-CT图像有限,限制了对需要配对数据的深层学习方法的培训[6、3]。 其次,手术后肝脏转移,呼吸运动和病人再定位引入了非刚性畸形,而刚性对接[6]无法充分捕捉. 第三,一些未发酵的深层以学习为基础的可变形登记方法依赖相应的解剖标签来指导对齐[6];在手术内CT中获取可靠的肿瘤标签对于大型数据集来说是挑战性的,因为损伤能见度低,需要昂贵的专家说明[13]. 直接学习合同委员会内部CT的本地化同样受到管理标签培训数据所需的大量专家努力的限制。 这些挑战限制了基于注册的标签转让
并直接学习低等损伤的本地化
CT能见度,如HCC. 例如,在使用肿瘤标签登记MR和CT图像时,最近的方法只达到0.16-0.19分的损伤分数[13].
这些小肿瘤 虱子分数与所报告的解剖结构分数为0.72的虱子分数形成对比,强调更广泛的解剖对接不一定能确保准确的肿瘤标签转移[13,14].

blocks.en: Rather than transferring patient-specific tumour coordinates through registration, we propose to transfer learned tumour appearance information through weak supervision. A tumour presence classifier is first trained on MR images with binary labels indicating HCC tumour presence or absence. This classifier is then applied on local windows of intra-operative CT images, where it is able to generate the tumour-presence classification probability (from logits). Our central hypothesis is that, despite the modality gap, the classifier retains sufficient discriminatory information for tumour-containing windows to receive higher tumour-presence classification probabilities on average than windows without tumour. These classification probabilities are a ‘weak’ signal of cancer presence likelihood [ 18 , 21 , 19 ] , with higher values indicating higher cancer presence likelihood within the window. Despite the domain gap to CT, the windows with cancer lead to higher probabilities on average compared to windows without cancer based on preliminary results from bootstrapped averages. The task of localising cancer in the CT image then becomes finding the areas where windows lead to higher classification probabilities on average. We formulate this localisation using reinforcement learning (RL), where an agent moves a window across the CT image, and receives a classification probability-derived reward signal guiding the search towards areas of higher cancer likelihood. Window-level classification probabilities are spatially aggregated using maximum probability retention to generate a tumour score map, thresholded to obtain a segmentation.
blocks.zh: 与其通过注册转移患者特有肿瘤坐标,不如建议通过薄弱监管来转移所学到的肿瘤外观信息. 肿瘤存在分类器首先在MR图像上被训练出有二进制标签,显示HCC肿瘤存在或缺失. 这个分级器随后被应用到手术内CT图像的局部窗口上,在那里它能够产生肿瘤-存在分级概率(从logits). 我们的中心假设是,尽管模式存在差距,分类器保留了足够的含有肿瘤的窗口的歧视性信息,以获得高于没有肿瘤的窗口的肿瘤存在分类概率. 这些分类概率是癌症存在可能性的 " 弱 " 信号[18、21、19],更高的数值表明在窗口内癌症存在的可能性更高。 尽管CT的域位差距很大,但与没有癌症的窗口相比,有癌症的窗口平均比没有癌症的窗口的概率更高,其依据是靴子化的平均值的初步结果. 将癌症定位在CT图像中的任务,然后会发现窗户平均导致更高分类概率的区域. 我们利用强化学习(RL)来制定这种本地化,在CT图像上,一个代理人移动一扇窗口,并收到一个分类概率衍生的奖励信号,引导搜索到癌症可能性较高的地区. 窗口级分级概率用最大概率保留来生成肿瘤分数图,被阈值以得到分分.

blocks.en: We investigate three strategies for deriving the weak supervision signal. Firstly, the MR-trained classifier is simply applied to the CT images, in a ‘zero-shot’ setting. Secondly, the MR-trained classifier is fine-tuned on a few CT examples, in a ‘few-shot’ setting. Lastly, ‘synthetic transfer’, uses a cycle generative adversarial network (GAN) to translate the CT image into synthetic MR before localisation, where the CycleGAN itself is trained using unpaired CT and MR images only. It is noteworthy that our proposed framework circumvents the need for paired data or tumour segmentation labels.
blocks.zh: 我们调查了三种战略,以产生薄弱的监督信号。 首先,MR训练的分级器被简单地应用于CT图像,在"零镜头"的设定中. 第二,MR训练的分类器在 " few-shot " 的环境下,对几个CT的例子进行了微调。 最后,`合成转移 ' 使用循环基因对抗网络(GAN),在本地化之前将CT图像翻译为合成MR,其中CyleGAN本身只使用未发酵的CT和MR图像进行训练. 值得注意的是,我们提议的框架回避了配对数据或肿瘤分化标签的需要。

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarised: 1) a weakly supervised framework for transferring pre-operative tumour appearance information to intra-operative localisation, without requiring paired images or tumour masks in the zero-shot setting; 2) an RL-based tumour search strategy that uses the pre-operative image trained classifier’s classification probabilities as weak signals to guide tumour localisation on intra-operative images; 3) comparative evaluation of zero-shot, few-shot and synthetic image transfer strategies for localising HCC in intra-operative CT using a pre-operative MR-trained tumour classifier.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下: 1)将术前肿瘤外观信息转移给术后局部化的受弱监督的框架,而不需要在零射场设置中配对图像或肿瘤口罩;2)基于RL的肿瘤搜索策略,将术前被训练的图像分级概率作为弱信号来指导术后影像上肿瘤分级;3)对术后CT中将HCC分级定位的零射,少射和合成图像分级策略进行比较评价,使用术前MR训练的肿瘤分级.

2.4 Enhancing the classifier-derived weak signal

blocks.en: 2.4.1 Zero-shot transfer

blocks.en: 3 Experiments
blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: 3.1 Data
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据

blocks.en: MR data: 334 patients from LLD-MMR [ 11 ] , ATLAS [ 16 ] , CHAOS [ 10 ] . All volumes were resampled to 1.0 mm isotropic spacing, cropped to 128 × \times 128 × \times 128 voxels, clipped at the 0.5th and 99.5th intensity percentiles, and z-score normalised.
blocks.zh: MR数据:来自LLD-MMR [11],ATLAS [16],CHAOS [10]的334名患者. 所有卷被重印为相距1.0毫米,被收成为128××分128×分128分活塞,被剪到0.5和99.5分之百分位,并被Z分数正常化.

blocks.en: CT data: 313 patients from WAW-TACE [ 1 ] , CHAOS-CT [ 10 ] , and an internal dataset from [REC=14/LO/1264, IRAS=158321], including both pre- and intra-operative data. All volumes were windowed to -100 to +400 HU, resampled to 1.5 mm isotropic spacing, and z-score normalised.
blocks.zh: CT数据:来自WAW-TACE [1],CHAOS-CT [10]的313名患者,以及来自[REC=14/LO/1264,IRAS=158321]的内部数据集,包括手术前和手术后的数据. 所有卷被窗口为-100至+400 HU,被重印为1.5毫米同位素间距,并实现z分数常态化.

blocks.en: Both datasets were partitioned into development and validation sets using a 70%/30% split at the patient-level. Evaluation is reported on TCIA HCC-TACE-Seg (105 patients) [ 7 ] , where volumes had radiologist voxel-wise tumour annotations as ground truth. We focus on HCC which is conventionally challenging to identify on intra-operative CT images [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 两个数据集都用70%/30%的分数在病人一级分拆,分为开发和验证组。 有关TCIA HCC-TACE-Seg(105名病人)[7]的评价报告,其中卷有放射学家的视狐狸的肿瘤说明作为地真. 我们把重点放在合同委员会上,它通常对确定操作内CT图像具有挑战性。

blocks.en: 3.2 Networks and hyperparameters
blocks.zh: 3.2 网络和超参数

blocks.en: The classifier used SE-ResNet3D [ 9 ] (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , batch size 8). The CycleGAN used 3D encoder–decoder generators and multi-scale patch discriminators [ 22 , 8 ] . The RL agent used PPO [ 20 ] with a 3D convolutional network (learning rate 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , discount factor 0.99). Hyperparameters provided in repository. On a single Nvidia Quadro GV100 GPU, the classifier converged in 8 hours, the CycleGAN in 16 hours, and the RL tumour localisation in 48 hours.
blocks.zh: 分类员使用SE-ResNet3D [9](学习率10 - 3 10 - 3},批量尺寸8). CycleGAN使用了3D编码器-解码器生成器和多相位补丁分辨器[22,8]. RL代理使用PPO [20] 并有3D分流网络(学习率3×10−4 3\times 10×4},折扣系数0.99). 存储器中提供的超参数 。 在一单Nvidia Quadro GV100 GPU上,分级器在8小时后相接,循环GAN在16小时后相接,RL肿瘤在48小时后被定位.

blocks.en: 3.3 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3.3 实验装置

blocks.en: We compared zero-shot, few-shot and synthetic transfer with recent methods [ 13 , 6 ] . Few-shot adaptation fine-tuned the classifier on 40 development CT volumes; synthetic transfer trained the CycleGAN on the MR and CT development sets before localisation on synthetic MR. Registration methods used paired evaluation data specified in [ 13 ] , rather than our CT-only evaluation cohort. To ablate MR transfer, we trained CT-only RL baselines on the CT development set using rewards from tumour labels (full supervision; FS) or a CT-only classifier (weak supervision; WS). We included an FS nn-UNet trained on segmentation-labelled training data, as implemented in [ 12 ] . Sensitivity analyses assessed window size and segmentation threshold τ \tau . We report patient-level Dice ± \pm standard deviation, with t-tests for statistical comparisons. Localisation success rate is the proportion of individual discontiguous tumours across patients achieving Dice > 0.10 >0.10 , following [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了零发、零发和合成转移 与最近的方法[13、6]。 几发改编对分级器对40个开发CT卷进行了微调;合成转录在合成MR本地化之前,对循环GAN进行了MR和CT开发集的培训. 登记方法使用[13]所指定的配对评价数据,而不是我们只使用CT的评价组别。 为了放弃MR转移,我们利用从肿瘤标签(全面监管;FS)或只使用CT分类器(薄弱监管;WS)获得的奖励,在CT开发集上培训了CT-只使用RL的基线. 我们包括一个FS nn-UNet培训的分门别类的培训数据,在[12]中实施。 敏感性分析评估了窗口大小和分块阈值\ tau。 我们报告病人水平的 Dice ±\pm 标准差, 并有T测试进行统计比较。 本地化成功率是指在[13]后实现Dice > 0.10 > 0.10的患者中,个体无关联肿瘤的比例.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Synthetic transfer significantly outperformed other evaluated methods, suggesting that reducing the modality gap strengthens MR-trained classifier guidance. Comparatively poorer CT-only results highlight the value of MR-derived information. Despite a 93% localisation success rate, the Dice score of 0.31 indicates that HCC boundary delineation remains challenging and could be explored using alternative supervision.
blocks.zh: 合成转移大大地超过了被评价的其他方法,表明缩小模式差距会加强MR训练的分类器指导. 相对较差的只使用CT的结果突出了MR派生信息的价值. 尽管本地化成功率为93%,但Dice的分数为0.31,这表明合同委员会边界的划定仍然具有挑战性,可以利用其他监督方法加以探索。

blocks.en: We developed a weakly supervised framework that uses an MR-trained classifier to guide liver tumour localisation on CT without paired MR–CT training images. This demonstrates the potential of transferring learned tumour appearances across modalities through weak supervision.
blocks.zh: 我们开发了一个弱监督框架,使用MR训练分级器指导肝肿瘤在CT上的定位,而不配对MR-CT训练图像. 这表明,通过薄弱的监管,有可能将所学得的肿瘤外观跨模式转移。
